review_description: We wanted to go with a locally owned Company from our area and from the initial contact with Ben to the final install and instructions on the app nothing was too much trouble for all the staff. The install team went about their job in a professional, courteous manner, which showed we had made the right decision. From quote to install around 10 days and arrived on time as expected. Would not hesitate to recommend Solana Energy Specialists to anyone who wants to deal with a very competent, experienced Company with a good quality product.

The entire process with Solana was remarkably straightforward and reassuring. Immediately after submitting my initial inquiry, a representative (Ben) made contact to book a thorough in-home consultation. We spent quality time discussing my past energy usage and clearly outlining my goals for solar power. It was comforting to know that Solana was focused on quoting a configuration that would genuinely suit my specific needs, not just a standard package.The coordination was flawless; communication between the office team and the tradespeople was great. On the day of the installation, everything went well and proceeded smoothly. Furthermore, I have been happy with the administrative support post-installation and the prompt assistance I received when following up with a couple of questions. Solana delivered exactly as promised.

Right from the quotation stage we were impressed with the service. They were the only Company that came on site prior to submitting a quote.Although the price was higher than others the service offered, the warranty period and dealing with their own people not contractors sealed the deal for us.The installation was done in two lots, owing to bad weather. The crew were great, on time, polite, completed the job on time and cleaned up.The grid connection was done and we were shown how to download the app.Would recommend this Company.

Can't get any information from installer or supplier. Won't return any phone calls or emails. Wasn't shown anything on installation. Customer service doesn't exist. I won't recommend this mob to anybody at all. Took the money and ran!
Installation guys were very good, customer service excellent and the salesperson gave honest advice and recommendations.

The whole process was quick and very efficient. Salesman was attentive in answering all my requests. The installation was polite , tidy and punctual. Price was a bit cheaper than the other quotes and they could do the job earlier.Only two minor complaints. I didn’t get any instructions on getting the monitoring app working. I didn’t get a hot water switch as promised. Although this is going to be  remedied in January, after a call to the salesman.

After thorough research, I went with Solana as I wanted Tiger Jinko Neo solar panels over LONGi, but then just after I committed, the 2024 results came out and LONGi turns out to have the edge.Solana came in at $100 less than the lowest quote to get my business. In the end, there's really nothing in between them and their nearest competitor. Warranties and products are all very good.Solana were very efficient and got everything in and sorted within two weeks.My only dislike, is that after I committed I found that the salesperson's mobile was no longer answered immediately, and I needed to text or email to reach them, and then they would call me back. It was only at this time that I realised no office number was to be found. This can be frustrating for some people, who like to call and leave a messages. Personally I can't stand texting, emailing and waiting. The only negative in this sale. Otherwise they were very good and answered all my queries and met all my needs.

After a short delay and a follow up phone call, Solana arranged an on site visit to assess our requirements and prepare a quotation. Patrick patiently and comprehensively answered our questions and gave a good overview of the system proposed to meet our needs. We accepted Solana's quote shortly afterwards and installation was scheduled two weeks later .After a one day delay due to weather conditions, installation proceeded and was completed on the one day . Prior to commencement, the Supervising Electrician , Tim, ran through the process and confirmed the location for the inverter, roof access etc. All went very smoothly. The team worked carefully and safely and we are very happy with the installation work and appearance of the system.Tim submitted the required paperwork to our energy supplier to arrange Grid connection and provided an overview of the SEMS+ App . The "App" is recording we are achieving the estimated production and consumption rates.

Sales and quoting process was great. They were really good and helped me with a lot of concerns. The competition was recommending 27 optimisers one for each panel. Russel said there was no need, and we would add them as required.Installation went well, the guys who came on site were on time and really helpful. There was an issue the parts that were sent to do the install however they got me sorted on the day and came back a few days later to finish the job.I asked about the optimisers and was told they were not in stock, and they would be back out to sort it. Since then the office helped me with my connection to the grid and everything was worked out with my energy provider well.Sadly no one will reply to me about the optimisers, I have requested to be called multiple times and have been told they will get in touch with me, but no one ever does. There is a bank of 9 panels that gets the edge 2-4 panels shaded every afternoon causing my output to drop dramatically just when we start loading the power to get ready for the evening. I really do hope they honor the install proposal and finalize the order.
Very early in the process.  Too early to tell how the system is benefitting.

I went with Solana because of the 475W Jinko panels they offered, and they offered Sungrow inverter/consumption meter. I was very happy with the sales guy Tom who took me through everything and ran some very approximate/optimistic calculations which they all seem to do. He answered all questions and concerns promptly. One of the points he made was that they do not sub-contract out the install, so quality should be higher and issues should be resolved easier...I was informed that there would be a few weeks delay due to lead time on the Sungrow products which was fine. I woke up one morning to a phone call stating that the installers would be there in 1 hour! Obviously some mixed communication going on on their end as I was never informed or asked to confirm an install date, which is pretty crazy considering they were travelling from Newcastle for a Sydney install.I was happy with the install - the guys were friendly and flexible with me choosing the inverter position.As soon as the system was turned on during summer, I had been getting a particular inverter fault every 1-2 days which meant solar production was halted for something like 20 minutes - not a big deal in itself, but obviously it's not supposed to fault all the time, and could be indicative of an actual problem. I emailed them and got a prompt response saying they'll look into it. A month later, after following up with them 3 times via email, not a peep from them. The fault has for some reason subsided, but I assume it'll come back in the summer.Despite being pretty happy with everything, even with the mismanaged install time, it doesn't seem like support/communication is a priority for them - for this reason I would go with another company if I had my way again.

Very happy with the sales and installation process. The initial design was modified several times following the roof inspection and changed even during installation due to the complexity and various constraints of the site. However, a month after installation, I’m still waiting for AGL to connect to the grid. That is not SOLANA’s fault, but be prepared to do some chasing up.

The quoting process was quite easy, with some back-and-forths on size and price options but Tom was easy to contact and quick to respond.The installer was great, came on a particularly warm day but was quick and tidy.I ended up contacting my Supplier about the grid connection but was advised that paperwork has been submitted as well from the installerWas initially quoted a GoodWe inverter but due to a stock shortage was upgraded to a GE

Quoting process was easy, it was not the most expensive or the cheapest. Seemed like an honest genuine sales rep. Installation, polite, tidy, punctual and informative. Slight hiccup with organising grid connection after install it was hard to reach them, I felt that once I had installed the system they didn’t get back. However I was called several days later as the customer service rep was sick hence the delay. I am pleased with this company, I did have reservations at first as they didn’t have as many year’s experience as other companies but I am very happy with how it all worked out
Excellent service, quality package and sales were not pushy and freely have their time to answer any and all questions. After install service and support is also top notch. Thanks guys!
Polite and knowledgeable salesman. Reliable and punctual. Comparable price. Good follow up after installation. Efficient installation. Well mannered installers.
